verdicts.reason: In both, the SAVE 15% badge is huge and bleeds off the left edge, so it pulls the eye away from the headline. The coffee bag has shrunk to a tiny icon next to an equally tiny logo, and the photo panel is just a blurry brown box with no product in it. A keeps the body copy on one clean line, but its CTA is very small and the photo panel is cut off at the right edge. B wraps the body copy into a cramped two-line block with an orphaned 'whenever you like.' line, and its empty photo panel floats in the middle with dead space to its right, so B is slightly worse.
